rate_offered.notes: Printed '+1.10% הצמדה למדד': a real rate plus linkage to the index (BANK-36), recorded as printed. Row 'חסכון אודם לשנתיים', rate type 'קבועה', linkage 'צמוד למדד המחירים לצרכן', amount '25,000 עד 100,000 ש"ח', break 'אין אפשרות לשבירה', automatic renewal 'לא קיימת', number of renewals 'לא קיימת', exit points 'לא קיימת'. The board's savings page (p.4) says this saving 'מעניק הבטחת קרן' (BANK-36). This row as printed: '25,000 עד 100,000 ש"ח': '+1.10% הצמדה למדד'. Read 2026-11-14 on p.6 of the file the bank's deposits page links (https://www.bank-yahav.co.il/investments/deposits/), re-issued on 10.11.2026, headed 'בתוקף מיום: 11/11/2026' with '10/11/2026 11_26' under the date (library eeb6aefc72e67b13); every figure this record takes from p.6 is as it was. The common-deposit column is empty on every row.

source.title: פקודת מס הכנסה [נוסח חדש], נוסח רשות המסים, עמ' 204, סעיף 125ג(ב); עמ' 41, סעיף 9(13)

tax_bucket.notes: Read as fully linked to the consumer price index on the 447 table's linkage column alone (quoted in the notes of rate_offered); no terms document of this deposit was read for its linkage, so whether the linkage is full, which the bucket needs (TXI-04: a deposit counts as linked only when fully linked to the index), rests on that column. Fully linked: the linkage differentials are exempt (TXI-05) and the interest above the linkage is taxed at up to 25% (TXI-02), at a lower bracket from age 60 (TXI-19). Copied from the rule base (sources read there 2026-10-25), not re-read today. The engine reads no tax_bucket today.

break.mechanism_text: 'אפשרות לשבירת פיקדון: אין אפשרות לשבירה' (447 table column, printed once for every row). The account agreement (s.6.1.1, p.36) says that if the bank allows an early withdrawal 'לפנים משורת הדין', the money withdrawn bears no interest or linkage and the bank may charge 'בסכום השווה לנזק שיגרם לבנק' (BANK-33, BANK-48).
